depiction.composition: single object with centered interior symbol

readings.meaning: check reviews, ratings, or quality evaluation
discover highlights, recommendations, or best options
talent scouting or finding top candidates

ambiguity: Can be confused with a plain search icon at small sizes, or taken literally as astronomy/stargazing if the magnifier is misread as a telescope lens.

modifier_semantics.meaning: favorite, bookmarked, top-rated, or quality review

Look through Glassdoor reviews before confirming the final panel interview on Thursday
Audit our Google Business star ratings and flag the three fake reviews
Check Consumer Reports reliability scores for used midsize SUVs under twenty grand
Read through recent App Store 1-star reviews to see what broke in v4.2
Set up a saved search alert on StreetEasy for two-bedrooms under $3500 in Astoria
Cross-check contractor ratings on Angi and Google before paying the deposit for the roof

example_tasks_es: Revisar las reseñas verificadas en Amazon antes de pedir el deshumidificador
Guardar búsqueda con alerta en Idealista para pisos con terraza en Chamberí
Comparar valoraciones de talleres mecánicos cerca de casa
example_tasks_ru: Почитать отзывы на Яндекс.Маркете про роботы-пылесосы с базой самоочистки
Настроить сохраненный поиск на Циане для двушек рядом с парком

context_tasks.task: Write a 5-star review for the plumber who fixed the main valve
Export search analytics report for Q3

near_misses.task: Buy a 5-star rated surge protector for the TV console
Check if the passport renewal arrived in the mail
Plan one proper dark-sky stargazing night before the full moon
Zoom in on the PDF floorplan to check outlet placements
Call the top-rated roofer to schedule a Tuesday inspection

reasoning: A magnifying glass containing a five-pointed star clearly communicates saved searches, bookmarked queries, or researching ratings and reviews. While searching is a generic action, managing saved search alerts and evaluating customer reviews are common, distinct task concepts in shopping, house-hunting, and work.
